213281aaa309fdd3.column_purpose: Reference to the event table (Airtable-style record id). Identifies which event the attendance record is for.

dac7583ac44d1bdc.column_purpose: Reference to the member table (Airtable-style record id). Identifies which member attended the event.

6051292c92e48d80.column_purpose: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for the budget line item. Referenced by expense.col_007, linking expenses to their budget line.

40fe084ec9a9c2a1.column_purpose: Budget category/line item name, e.g. Food, Advertisement, Parking, Speaker Gifts, Club T-Shirts.

f8974e876aa375fb.column_purpose: Amount already spent against this budget line (currency, likely USD). Zero for open/planning items; grows as expenses are recorded. In samples, spent + remaining equals the allocated total.

f0083cbb011044da.column_purpose: Remaining balance of the budget line (currency). Equals allocated total minus spent; can be negative (min -24.25) when overspent. Sample values like 0.41/0.75 suggest cents-level tracking.

34225cc6bc62a15c.column_purpose: Total amount allocated to the budget line (currency, whole dollars). Consistent with spent + remaining in sample rows (e.g. 67.81 + 7.19 = 75).

a1f749a75b5907fd.column_purpose: Lifecycle status of the budget line: Planning, Open, or Closed.

5bd6d61408af700e.column_purpose: Foreign key to event.col_001; the event this budget line belongs to. Each event has several budget lines (many_to_one).

a39d7381860b3d64.column_purpose: Primary key; Airtable-style record id (rec...). Referenced by attendance and budget tables.

08334a34ef8b6fcd.column_purpose: Name/title of the event (e.g. 'Officers meeting - March', 'Habitat for Humanity').

68e6ab1134d00c82.column_purpose: Date and time the event occurs, ranging Sep 2019 to May 2020 (academic year).

b0d8ca8cb05666c5.column_purpose: Category of event: Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Community Service, Social, Budget, Election, etc.

fa178041893a9a2c.column_purpose: Free-text description/notes of the event; null for about half the rows (often meetings).

71e82af1ab76cdfb.column_purpose: Location of the event: campus room (MU 215), campus stadiums, or street addresses; null for some events.

1e750132653f770c.column_purpose: Event status: Planning, Open, or Closed (lifecycle of the event).

625cc353785da2ee.column_purpose: Primary key; unique record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID).

a332bdc92139f13d.column_purpose: Free-text description of what was purchased (e.g. 'Posters', 'Pizza', 'Water, chips, cookies', 'Club shirts').

773b2d749985aaea.column_purpose: Date the expense was incurred, ranging 2019-08-20 to 2019-11-19 (fall semester).

64a23c47dc75f1dd.column_purpose: Expense amount in dollars (min 6.00, max 295.12, mean ~65.19).

2e256347b80815a4.column_purpose: Boolean flag, always 'true' when present (31/32 rows; one null). Likely an approval/reimbursed flag, but since only one value is observed its exact meaning (approved vs. paid vs. reimbursed) is uncertain.

baf0e1952f62c300.column_purpose: Reference to member table (the member who incurred or submitted the expense); only 3 distinct members among the 32 expenses.

61f7869fbd159f78.column_purpose: Reference to budget table, i.e. the budget category/line the expense is charged to (e.g. Advertisement, Food, Parking).

55d9dea5484f8ed5.column_purpose: Primary key; opaque record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) uniquely identifying each income entry.

784e8a3c5e16669a.column_purpose: Date the income was received, ranging 2019-09-01 to 2019-10-31.

32977a0ee5406c5d.column_purpose: Amount of income in dollars. 33 of 36 rows are $50 (the standard membership dues amount); the three non-dues entries are $200, $1000, and $3000 (fundraising, sponsorship, school appropriation).

129a7f34a1a0437d.column_purpose: Source/category of the income: 'Dues' (33 rows), plus one each of 'Fundraising', 'Sponsorship', and 'School Appropration' (sic, likely 'School Appropriation').

62697d109bea0062.column_purpose: Optional free-text note describing the income; present only for the three non-dues entries (e.g. 'Annual funding from Student Government.', 'Secured donations to help pay for speaker gifts.', 'Ad revenue for use on flyers used to advertise upcoming events.').

0548025948c79ddf.column_purpose: Reference to member.col_001, the member associated with the income (the person who paid dues or secured the fundraising/sponsorship). Null for one row (likely the school appropriation, which has no individual member).

a03f0ead08222659.column_purpose: Primary key. Airtable-style record ID ('rec...' prefix) uniquely identifying each major; referenced by member.col_009 (a member's major).

ab61b86aec568262.column_purpose: Name of the academic major/degree program (e.g., 'History', 'Environmental Engineering'). Unique across the 113 rows.

02b3fcb197ba1bab.column_purpose: Name of the academic department or school administering the major (e.g., 'History Department', 'Applied Economics Department').

704ba620e6b527f6.column_purpose: Name of the college the major belongs to (e.g., 'College of Agriculture and Applied Sciences', 'College of Engineering').

f1123482ff39a3e0.column_purpose: Primary key; opaque record identifier (Airtable-style 'rec...' ID) for each member. Referenced by attendance, expense, and income tables.

528e51a7635d1735.column_purpose: Member's email address, in the pattern firstname.lastname@lpu.edu (university email).

f91024b867477389.column_purpose: Membership status/role: 'Member' (regular active member), 'Inactive', or an officer role (President, Secretary, Treasurer).

c84f5f82092c1134.column_purpose: Member's t-shirt size (Small, Medium, Large, X-Large); likely for club apparel orders.

7d8092c306dac3f0.column_purpose: Member's phone number (US format, some with area code in parentheses, some not; 555 exchange numbers indicate synthetic/sample data).

65d305377f5adee2.column_purpose: Member's home ZIP code (US postal code), referencing zip_code lookup table.

6efe5b39d3204f20.column_purpose: Reference to the member's academic major in the major lookup table; null for some members (e.g., inactive ones), so major is optional.

43ef6a577b07ee3f.column_purpose: 5-digit US ZIP code; primary key of the table, referenced by member.col_008.

a953e49e4396a0cc.column_purpose: USPS ZIP code type: Standard, PO Box, or Unique (organization-specific).

6fae9ff021352a54.column_purpose: City (or post office / place name) associated with the ZIP code.

5527643b26fa8008.column_purpose: County (or county-equivalent such as borough, municipio, census area) containing the ZIP code.

4c1bf4ea69ec5d7f.column_purpose: Full state name (includes territories, e.g. Puerto Rico).

43dc7a1791d519a2.column_purpose: Two-letter USPS state/territory abbreviation matching col_005.
